area-between-x-strip.alt: The region between the parabola y = 6 − x² (on top) and the line y = x (on the bottom), shaded from x = −3 to x = 2, where they meet at (−3, −3) and (2, 2). One thin vertical rectangle of width Δx has height (6 − x²) − x. A side panel shows the limits from 6 − x² = x and the area, the integral from −3 to 2 of [(6 − x²) − x] dx = 125/6.
